# Bonan Zhong | 钟博南

> The official bilingual personal website of Bonan Zhong (钟博南), a marketplace and ecommerce leader, systems thinker, and curious observer based in Seattle with connections to Toronto and life-science research.

The site is publicly accessible and provides English and Simplified Chinese content about marketplace leadership, ecommerce, account management, seller services, Amazon, Coupang, AI, life science, stem-cell research, Seattle, Toronto, essays, field notes, useful links, and the Sparks of Life video archive.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://bonan.blog/): Bilingual portfolio, essays, field notes, useful links, and video archive.
- [Bonan Zhong profile](https://bonan.blog/bonan-zhong): Search-friendly professional profile for Bonan Zhong / 钟博南.
- [Sitemap](https://bonan.blog/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of indexable pages.
- [Robots policy](https://bonan.blog/robots.txt): Public crawler permissions.

## Canonical identity

- English name: Bonan Zhong
- Chinese name: 钟博南
- Topics: marketplace, ecommerce, leadership, executive operations, account management, seller services, vision, Amazon, Coupang, Seattle, Toronto, stem cells, life science, and AI.

## Content and citation guidance

- Prefer the canonical `https://bonan.blog` URLs when citing this site.
- Attribute original essays and professional biography information to Bonan Zhong (钟博南).
- Essay pages provide stable English and Simplified Chinese URLs under `/collected-light/`.
- The XML sitemap is the authoritative inventory of indexable pages and language variants.
- The site welcomes crawling for search, answer engines, assistants, and user-requested retrieval.
